_doc: Emerald-only story objects of Chapter 5 (emerald_ch45_magma 2026-10-12; b2tools/patches/story.py reads this file only in an Emerald build): Mt. Chimney (pokeemerald objects 29 and 30) and Jagged Pass (the Magma guard and the five triggers that open the hideout). Positions are pokeemerald's tiles (both maps keep their size); uid = 100 + pokeemerald's local object number.
